title: ARPAPED Bridge Protocol
description: Language-agnostic shape of the request, response, and error a canonical Bridge exchanges with a consumer. Any Bridge implementation, in any language, exposes data matching these three shapes. See bridge/MANIFEST.yaml for where this ecosystem's actual implementation lives.

policyContext.description: The five policy-decision sources kept explicit and out of the capability body.

request.description: What a consumer passes to the Bridge's handle operation.

contract_version.description: Required contract version, e.g. an exact version or a range like ">=1.0.0".

operation.description: Operation name from the capability's contract.

input.description: Operation input, shaped by the contract.

response.description: What the Bridge's handle operation returns on success.

output.description: Operation output, shaped by the contract.

error.description: What the Bridge raises when a request cannot complete.

stage.description: The trace stage where the error occurred.
